description: This bar chart illustrates the average performance across eleven datasets for five different training methods, with the vertical axis labeled “Average Performance” scaled linearly from 0 to 60 in increments of 10, and the horizontal axis listing the training methods: “Standard”, “Self-RAG”, “FactTune”, “ClinGS (w/)”, and “ClinGS”. Each method is represented by a single vertical bar with a distinct color: “Standard” is orange, “Self-RAG” is beige, “FactTune” is lime green, “ClinGS (w/)” is blue-gray, and “ClinGS” is royal blue. The bars are arranged in ascending order of their height from left to right, with the “Standard” method showing an average performance of approximately 54, “Self-RAG” at approximately 55, “FactTune” at approximately 52, “ClinGS (w/)” at approximately 55, and “ClinGS” reaching the highest value of approximately 60. No bars are shaded or annotated beyond their color coding, and the chart does not include a legend, though the method names are directly labeled beneath each respective bar.
